fato_historico: 1356: Basel earthquake, the most significant historic seismological event north of the Alps, destroys the town of Basel, Switzerland.
energia_do_dia: The earth shifts beneath your feet today, perhaps mirroring the historic tremors that once reshaped ancient landscapes. Rather than fearing instability, consider this a cosmic invitation to rebuild your foundation with resilience. It is a good time to focus on your internal structure, allowing your ambition to settle into a new, more peaceful rhythm of quiet growth.
frase_do_dia: Build your dreams upon the bedrock of your own unwavering inner courage.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of wisdom through disciplined life experiences and steady progress.
conselho: Stand tall, trust your roots, and let go of what no longer serves you.
